summary: Accepted both PAIRING-011 candidates after distinct mathematical review without edits to frozen inputs. The accepted conclusion is the specified xY log^(-A) raw-minus-comparison difference, not a bound for Qmajor itself. Preserved the common eligible ambient scope, positive absolute one-edge bad-state argument, actual signed cofactor support, psi plateau, endpoint conjugation and exact ordered shared-list normalization. Finite checks passed only within their declared scope: geometric coverage has 25 pairs and maximum cell distance zero, some full J2 toy masses vanish, separate factorial cases are nonzero, and the full physical kernel identity17 and analytic estimates are not computationally certified. The next analytic boundary is actual-coefficient major energy. No actual-prime parity, full-source validation, polynomial-rough/nonzero-center/h1 bridge, novelty or Goldbach claim is obtained. Usage is unknown.

claims.text: The reviewed positive expansion, signed nonnegative cofactor square, coprime determinant equivalence and shared-prime bounds retain their exact support and cutoff hypotheses.
The corrected eligible moment, endpoint ambient Gram argument, separate positive bad-edge replacement and ordered harmonic reassembly give the stated Qall-Qmajor difference in the declared regime.
The finite support, coefficient, pullback, sparse geometry and scalar ordered-weight checks passed, without certifying the full physical kernel identity or analytic asymptotics.
Shared determinant equality without integrality, omitted unit support, wrong conjugation, unchanged unordered factorials and norm stability under the positive-product mask are refuted variants.
The major comparison estimate, actual-prime and decomposition/weight-removal interfaces, polynomial-rough lower margin and prime boundary, novelty and Goldbach remain unestablished.
